_comment: EPISODE 2, TAKE A of three (seeds 4820, 4821, 4822). THE ONLY TAKE THAT ASKS THE QUESTION. Episode 1 carried `handover_first` in all three takes, so the interviewer asked at 0:00, 0:09 and 0:18 and the transcript ran 'Motor oil. Quick question. Any idea what is in this can?' together in one breath; that is what made the joins abrupt. Takes B and C are now answers only. product and location are IDENTICAL BYTE FOR BYTE across all three configs, which is what check-cut.py's provenance check C compares across the manifests rather than trusting this comment. Four grammars on: pace, guards, mic (the Klemens stick mic, pinned identical across all three takes) and plain (no lettering on anyone, adults only).

product.appearance: same white body, same dark blackletter lettering, same gold illustration
product.colour_ban: It never turns gold or yellow.
product.opening_extra: and no ring pull is touched

question: Quick question. What's in this can?
_props_comment: Plain and unprinted, every one. Episode 1's props included a printed carrier bag and a backpack with lettering and both rendered as mush. NO_LETTERING bans printing in the prompt; naming a printable prop in the config would put the two in an argument the model resolves however it likes.
